education.title: Oat beta-glucan
education.summary: Oat beta-glucan has evidence for lowering blood cholesterol under specific intake conditions.
education.evidence_reference: Health Canada, Oat Products and Blood Cholesterol Lowering (2010)
education.conditions: The reviewed claim concerns 3 g of oat beta-glucan per day from eligible oat products; product and serving conditions also apply.
education.limitations: Beta-glucan is not measured in this catalogue record. Total fibre cannot establish that dose; processing and product form matter. This is context, not a personal outcome prediction.

education.title: Psyllium as soluble fibre
education.summary: The AGA/ACG guideline identifies psyllium as soluble fibre and reports evidence for fibre supplementation in chronic idiopathic constipation.
education.evidence_reference: AGA/ACG clinical practice guideline (2023), fibre section
education.conditions: The guideline concerns adults with chronic idiopathic constipation and specific supplements; hydration and tolerability matter. It is not a recipe dosing recommendation.
